theme: An open day, four out from Croatia.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are with you in St. Pete, so the day is yours to spend. The pull is the September 8 departure: a few trip loops are still open while you've got dry-land wifi to close them.

needsAttention.title: Mike Lubrano wants that call on Nomura
needsAttention.detail: In your Valoris thread, Mike says you two 'still need to have a call' and wants to propose a real project for Nomura, though he doubts Chie has the budget. The next move is yours.

needsAttention.title: Send your bio to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your Sept 1 note to yourself is still open: Ellen Richstone and Deb Rosenthal need your email and bio for the NACD New England Oct 28 panel. Worth clearing before you fly.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and the St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two p1 lodging tasks on the board are overdue: the Sept 19 night in Cavtat after the charter, and the Sept 20-22 gap in St Pete before the kids' pickup. Both have to be booked from shore.

needsAttention.title: Confirm bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows zero checked bags. The board task (overdue Aug 25) is to verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags online before airport rates hit.

flagged.title: VP, State Government Affairs (remote)
flagged.detail: A Ladders/LinkedIn alert for a remote VP of State Government Affairs role in Maryland came in this morning.

flagged.title: C&C Sprayfoam estimate to review
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks estimate from C&C Sprayfoam is sitting in your inbox, marked due end of December -- worth a look, not a rush.

inbox.noise: Newsletters and promos -- NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, BoatUS, Slightly Foxed -- plus Airbnb trip confirmations.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply from you today.

resolved.title: PRI stewardship call held till you're back
resolved.detail: You told Kate Ehoe's office it isn't urgent; she replied to pick the diary back up when you return from the trip.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn brings winter squash to the market, and kabocha is at its sweetest now.

acts.line: No meetings on the books and the girls are with you, so the morning belongs to the house.
